channelTitle: An ache deep in the ear? Grandma June warms up a towel first
hook: Before reaching for anything else, this is the first, simplest thing to try for a nagging earache.
ingredientName: A warm towel or heating pad
remedy: Holding a warm towel or heating pad gently against the outside of the ear is an old home comfort measure for easing the ache of a minor earache.
steps: Warm a towel with hot water and wring it out, or use a low-heat heating pad
Wrap it in a thin cloth so it isn't too hot against the skin
Hold it gently against the outer ear for ten to fifteen minutes
caution: Never insert anything into the ear canal. See a doctor if the pain is severe, comes with fever, or there's any discharge from the ear.
cta: Does warmth help your earaches too, or do you have another trick? Let Grandma June know below.
